scene ineedyouback1
scene ineedyouback2
: I could have handled that, you know.
: It must have been hard for you.
: It’s my fault it came to this in the first place...
: I needed to be the one who did it.
: Fitting that you’d choose the most dramatic moment possible to start acting mature.
: Do you think they’ll forgive me, Shi-chan?
scene ineedyouback3
: I’d hope not. That would imply they remember you.
: If they ever find out, I mean...
: We don’t know how this world works. And my mom knew my name when I came to the roof, so...
scene ineedyouback2
: Hm.
: Say they do...
: Then what?
: Will you risk even more to come back?
: Can I?...
: I don’t want them to take mine next. I need to hang onto these memories, no matter how painful they may be.
: You don’t need to. I could fix you right now. Make it so this never happened at all.
: Though, I guess that’s why you’re so afraid of being caught in the first place. So forget I said anything.
scene ineedyouback4
: You did the right thing, Himawari.
: They’d surely mope forever if they only knew what they lost.
: They really were the best parents a girl could ask for.
: It’s not fair that they have to suffer like this.
scene ineedyouback2
: There’s someone suffering in every world. No amount of wishing will ever change that.
: I will...one day.
: I’ll take what I’ve learned here and use it to make my dreams come true. Turn the world into a better place. One that’s free of caveats or monkeys’ paws.
: This again? Your interdimensional travel agency?
: It’s more than that and you know it.
: We all have dreams, Shiori-Senpai. Even you. You just won’t tell me the world that you want.
: It keeps you from interfering, doesn’t it?
: I might not be able to interfere at all soon...
: Will you watch over them if that happens? Make sure they don’t give up?
: I’ll see what I can do.
: This place is somewhat interesting. Despite how badly I wanted it to be boring.
: I imagine I’ll be back eventually. Assuming it actually lasts, which seems like a pretty big toss-up right now.
scene ineedyouback5
: Really?...
scene ineedyouback6
: There’s a girl here that interests me. I knew someone who looked like her once.
scene ineedyouback7
: What? Who?
: That’s all you’re getting. Which is already too much.
: Now, go. I’ll handle things from here. You’ve done enough and I don’t want you crying on me.
scene ineedyouback8
: ...Okay. But I’m asking you more about this next week.
: Two weeks from now would be preferable. I’m having you cover my next five shifts to make up for the fact that I am now an accomplice in corporate heresy. Remember?
: That’s fine...I figured it’d be more, honestly.
scene ineedyouback9
: It would be if you weren’t in such a pathetic state right now. I can’t help but feel bad for you.
: Thank you, Senpai. Again.
: It really means a lot.
: So, where will you go next? The orchids are in bloom at Haadiya’s. You like flowers, don’t you?
: Yeah...
: There’s somewhere else I want to be right now, though...
scene black
: Yeah.
: Should have seen that coming.
scene ineedyouback10
: Tadaima...
scene ineedyouback11
: Hah...
: Wishful thinking will get you nowhere, Hima-chan.
scene black
: The future’s in their hands now...
scene ineedyouback12
: But I guess I still have you in the meantime, Che Guevara.
: I imagine it’ll be quiet here for a while. I’ll take you with me, though. I promise.
scene ineedyouback13
: There’s no rule against rabbits, thankfully. We just need to make sure you don’t become another bootstrap. Those fines add up, you know.
: Hey...
scene black
: You won’t feel lonely if I sleep in their bed tonight...
: Will you?
scene ineedyouback14
scene black
scene ineedyouback15
: Why do I feel like something terrible just happened to us?
scene ineedyouback16
: Right?! It’s like there’s a huge part of me missing all of a sudden.
: I feel like you’ve said something similar before.
scene ineedyouback17
: It has to be a reset, right? Weren’t we just at the beach? Or the...rooftop? I don’t know. You go.
: I think you’re right. But there’s...all this other stuff still swimming around in my head and...
: Uhh...Aomori doesn’t ring a bell, does it?
scene ineedyouback18
: It definitely does to me! But why does it ring a bell to you?! Stop looking into my dreams! It’s embarrassing!
: No, I...I think I had the same one. We were married, right?
scene ineedyouback19
: What part of “embarrassing” don’t you understand?!
: Hey, guys?
scene ineedyouback20
: You’re both cute and all, but maybe stop flirting in public and wait until we’re at the hotel to kick things up a notch. Thanks.
: You’re disgusting.
We’re thrown right into the thick of things again, it seems.
But without much time for reprieve, all I can do is rapidly flip through the pages of mental notes I must have scribbled between my last conscious moment and now.
Ayane and I made it through another reset. But I have no idea what that means for everyone else.
Nor do I understand why I’m suddenly suspicious of Ami or why looking at Maya fills me with an even deeper sense of dread than normal. Maybe Ayane can help fill me in on that, though.
But the question now is when. Because it is apparently Halloween and we are even more apparently on the way to a hotel right now.
: Come to think of it, you guys have been acting pretty weird all morning. Where’s all your Christmalloween spirit?
: Sorry. Our what?
: Christmalloween spirit. You know — the spirit of Christmalloween. The thing that powers Santa’s sleigh so he can deliver candy to kids in costumes all across the globe.
scene ineedyouback21
: Oh no. We’ve finally broken the world.
: Ami, there’s Christmas and there’s Halloween. Stop making up holidays just to fuck with me while my brain is clearly in a state of sudden recovery.
scene ineedyouback22
: Please be advised that all limited express trains on the Christmalloween holiday timetable are facing delays of up to five minutes.
: The next limited express train bound for Shiori-eki is arriving at platform two now.
: Oh my fucking god. We did break the world.
scene ineedyouback23
: If something’s wrong, we can always go back home. I’m kind of worried that everyone is going to hit on me tonight anyway. This whole masculine look works shockingly well for me, doesn’t it?
: We can swap costumes if that’s something you’re actually worried about, Ami. Because if one more person bumps into my tail, I’m going to throw them onto the tracks.
scene ineedyouback24
: Just take the tail part off then. You’re the one who decided to wear such a complicated costume to the station on the busiest day of the year.
: I can’t. There’s a gaping hole in the back of the costume that the tail plugs into. And I’m not about to invite an entire train worth of people to screw me from behind.
scene ineedyouback25
: That’s what your dad is for.
: You know what? Maybe we should swap costumes.
scene black
: Come on, Maya! To the restroom! We’ll catch the next-
: Ah! No! Don’t just get on! Your idea was good!
scene ineedyouback26
: Okay, so...Halloween and Christmas have combined into one holiday. That’s...fine. That’s not that big of a change, right? It could be worse!
: Oh, sure. It could definitely be worse. But if something like that changed, who knows what else we’re going to find out next?
scene ineedyouback27
: M...Maybe there are some good changes too! Like maybe, they’ve lowered the legal age of-
: Yeah, or maybe they’ve raised it and legalized guns and you’re about to get me murdered in the middle of a crowded train. This is not the time to be optimistic, Ayane.
scene ineedyouback28
: Well, I’m sorry! But being optimistic is the only way I know how to keep myself from crying right now! I’m really serious about feeling like something’s missing!
: Me too. I get it. But there’s a ton of shit I’m feeling right now that I don’t know what to make of. Take Ami and Maya for example.
scene ineedyouback29
: I know. Ami looks annoyingly hot in that costume. I’m supposed to be the hot one. This isn’t fair.
: That’s not what I mean and you know it...
scene ineedyouback30
: You feel like she knows something too then?
: There you go. But why?
: To be honest, I’ve felt that way for a while. Something about the way she acts with Maya sets off all sorts of alarms in my head.
: It’s definitely stronger now, though. You don’t think something happened with her during the apocalypse, do you?
: I don’t know. I...
: I remember her bringing me some sort of gift at the beach. But everything after that is-
scene aboxabox43
scene ineedyouback31
: Ngh?!
: Akira? Are you okay? You look really sick all of a sudden.
: Yeah, I’m fine. I...what did you just call me?
scene ineedyouback32
: Akira. Your...name?
: Yeah, but don’t you normally call me Sensei?
: Didn’t I start calling you Akira recently? Calling you Sensei feels kind of weird now.
: Just...forget the names for a second. We need to try and figure out what’s going on here. This feels different from the other resets.
scene ineedyouback33
: I agree. Let’s meet up with Makoto once we get to the hotel and see if she has anything to add.
: I’ll try talking to Ami once we get off the train too, but I can’t guarantee she’ll tell me anything given the type of girl she is. That said-
: I’ll talk to Maya. I just...don’t really know what to talk to her about since the theory floating around in my head right now is utterly ridiculous.
scene ineedyouback34
: Just out of curiosity, that theory wouldn’t happen to be that Kumon-mi is a world of her creation and that we all just got sucked into it, right?
scene ineedyouback28
: Just what the heck happened in this reset?!
scene ineedyouback35
: Maya. Wait up a second.
: You sure that’s a good idea with your niece and girlfriend so close by? I think the mistress normally needs to wait.
: You’re not my mistress. I just need to talk to you about something. And I understand that this probably isn’t the right time, but-
: It’s definitely not the right time. Because either it’s good and I become too clingy and piss Ami off. Or it’s bad and we get into a big fight right before a party. And then I piss Ami off.
: Ami’s basically just always pissed off at me now. So if you want to tell me anything, it needs to be in private. With our clothes off.
: Maya-
: Fine. That last part is optional. I’ll make an exception since it’s Christmalloween and I look hot in this costume.
: Christmalloween isn’t a real holiday. Ayane and I just went through another reset and now even the calendar is somehow fucked up.
: Sensei, I’ve come around to being a clone of myself. And I’ve come around to the apparent fact that this world is part of an infinitely repeating cycle.
: But you will not convince me that Christmalloween isn’t real. That is where I draw the line.
: Maya, I’m being serious. And I think you’re somehow a major part of this.
: Well, yeah. I figured that to be the case as well given the last me was willingly cuckolded for millions of years. What’s your point?
: My point is, I...
: What if...you made this world?
scene ineedyouback36
: What?
: Like...say you made a wish one day. And-
: Why in a trillion years would I wish for a world like this? This place sucks. I can’t even sleep with the guy I like because it makes him too sad.
: I...don’t really get it either. But when Ayane and I snapped out of it a little while ago, we were both thinking the same thing. Which means that there was probably something that-
: Implanted that thought in you because it wants to eliminate me. I read manga. I know how this works. But you don’t seriously believe that, do you?
: I’ve done everything you’ve asked. I’m open to learning all you know about this place. Don’t pivot to making me the antagonist now. That’s not fair at all.
: I’m not calling you an antagonist at all. I’m just-
: You’re absolutely calling me an antagonist if you’re going to just blatantly blame me for creating the world where all you do is suffer and bitch and-
: Maya, I love you.
scene ineedyouback37
: Wha- now?!
: I just-
scene ineedyouback38
: You say that now?! Of all times?! On Christmalloween?! Literally sixty seconds after I tell you that I’ll get too clingy if you say anything good to me?! Are you insane?!
: Probably. And there’s a good chance this could all be the result of some sort of delusion.
scene ineedyouback39
: But if it’s true, I...
: I don’t know.
: There’s still...something missing. There’s a part I don’t understand.
: I don’t know what to do if that is true.
: But...you love me.
: Me. Not the old Maya. You love me.
: Right?
: I love both of you, I think. I just don’t know when I realized that.
: I’m sorry for...springing that on you out of nowhere.
: Good. You should be.
: Now, I believe it is my turn to apologize.
: For what?
: For what I am going to do to you tonight.
scene ineedyouback40
: I wonder if Miss Watabe is going to be at the party?
: I’ve been writing a lot more lately and I really like talking to her about-
: Ami, are you aware that we’re caught in a timeloop and are just pretending not to know because you want to stay here forever?
: Yeah.
scene ineedyouback41
: Hah...of course you wouldn’t just-
scene ineedyouback42
: Yeah?!?!?
: Mhm.
: You’re just going to admit it?! You’re not going to hide it or try and kill me for finding out?!
: Why would I kill you? I like you.
scene ineedyouback43
: Because...isn’t it supposed to be a secret? Isn’t that something you’re trying to keep away from everyone?
: Not everyone. Just Sensei. So if you’re planning on relaying this to him, tell me now and I will kill you. But know that I will do it with a heavy heart. I might even shed a tear.
scene ineedyouback44
: Why just him?...
: Are you afraid he wouldn’t want to stay with you if he knew?...
: Of course not. I don’t question his love for me. But it’s because of his love for me that I have to keep this a secret.
: You see how he is with Maya. How all the time she spent searching for him is one more factor contributing to how upset he is about losing her.
: You don’t want to make him go through that again, do you? While he’s already questioning his adequacy as a father?
scene ineedyouback45
: If he finds out that I’m the same, it won’t be met with appreciation. It’ll be met by another panic attack and endless self-blame for not realizing it sooner. Then pity over what I’ve gone through.
: All things considered, I’d actually be the only one to benefit from him learning. Just think of all the attention I’d get.
scene ineedyouback46
: It would come at the cost of his pain, though.
: And if that pain became too great, I’d have no choice but to put him out of his misery.
scene ineedyouback47
: What...was that last part?
: A threat. And one that I know you will heed out of love.
: So do yourself and him a favor by staying in line or I will show you what it’s like to watch someone you love disappear. Do you under-
scene ineedyouback48
: Ngh!
: ...stand?
: My head is...killing me all of a sudden! Are you...the one doing this?!
: Yes, Ayane. My time as an immortal has granted me the power to give people headaches at will. Fear me.
: Again, it...feels like I’m forgetting something!
: Ngh!
scene ineedyouback49
: I think I have some Eve in one of my pockets if you want any. No pun intended.
: We can stop at a konbini and get you some water too. Maybe it’s dehydration?
scene black
: Th...Thank you!
: Mhm! That’s what friends are for.
: And once you’re feeling better, we’ll make this the greatest “Christmalloween” ever.
: I promise.
$ undeservedfuture18 = True
scene tobecontinued
scene black
